hook: SonicWall’s VPN MFA bypass is being exploited — plus 4 more

items.claim: SonicWall’s SSL‑VPN MFA bypass flaw (CVE‑2026‑19868) is being exploited
Hackers exploit Plex2Shell chain to breach QNAP NAS devices
319 malicious extensions hijacked searches of about 13.4 million Chrome users
Chrome 157 update patches 213 security issues, seven of them critical
Hackers stole credentials and live tokens for every Chainalysis customer

caption: Your devices face many hidden threats, from VPN logins to browser extensions. Keeping software up to date can block many of them. Which risk scares you more, the VPN MFA bypass or the Chrome search hijack?
alt_text: Five slides list security threats: SonicWall VPN MFA bypass exploited, QNAP NAS breach via Plex2Shell, 319 malicious Chrome extensions affecting 13.4 million users, Chrome 157 fixing 213 issues, and Chainalysis credential theft.
